The Together Dice only appears in Tag Team Rules in the Jamboree TV version of the Mario Party mode, replacing the Jamboree Buddies. It calls the player's teammate over to their space and both they and their teammate roll one of the two Dice Blocks. After rolling, the two rolls are combined and both the player and the teammate move together the combined distance. All board events that happen while this item is in use, such as buying items or getting a Star, will happen twice, similarly to the aforementioned Jamboree Buddies. After the turn is over, the teammate will return to their original space. It costs 20 coins at the Koopa Troopa Shop and only appears in the latter half of the game on every board, replacing one of the items that would be available at the shop otherwise. 

If both players roll the same number, they will receive 10 coins, similar to the result of rolling the same number with Double Dice.

Highlights:
Like with its predecessor, Super Mario Party Jamboree features the traditional Mario Party gameplay as the main mode of the ... ; players traverse a game board to collect coins in order to purchase Stars. The gameplay is overall more similar to Mario Party Superstars than Super Mario Party, sharing many of the same rules and mechanics, such as the dice rolling between one and ten and the occurrence of Bonus Minigames, where the coins won are doubled. Various new mechanics are introduced, including Jamboree Buddies, allies that grant the player a unique ability and trigger a space's effect twice upon landing, which serve as a revamped version of the ally mechanic from Super Mario Party. When a player passes by an unaffiliated Jamboree Buddy on the board, all players participate in a Showdown minigame, where the one who passed them is granted a slight advantage and the winner recruits the Jamboree Buddy.

Published: 2026-01-20T00:00:00.000Z

Highlights:
Tag Team Rules is the Partner Party equivalent of Super Mario Party, where players are in groups of 2. Like Partner Party, Stars and Coins are shared. However, there is a new item called the Together Dice. This is the same as a standard Double Dice but it brings the teammates together and shares the rolls. Like Jamboree Buddies, every event is doubled when using this dice. There are also Summon Spaces, which if landed on, bring the other teammates to the space. If players coincidently land on the same space, their team gets 5 coins (instead of 3).
